## Present warrant

This is a chosen editorial policy `[D]`, not a theorem of the Good and not a
scientifically validated result. Its maturity is `PROVISIONAL`. It becomes
`SUPPORTED` only if admitted independent outcomes show that applying it improves
error detection, correction, reversibility, or bearer protection against named
rivals without firing its kill criteria.

## Kill criteria

Narrow, supersede, or retract the Compact if it systematically blocks justified
action, hides real authority, makes correction harder, preserves harmful data
against valid deletion duties, or performs no better than simpler native audit
and decision practices.

evidence.text:
## 9 · Adoption and authority

The approved dimension-first work order seats this capstone, E1–E10, W0–W12,
the scoped G7 language, the five-candidate-crossing scaffold, and the D6
boundary relation **at their stated tiers**. Editorial adoption does not turn a
wager into evidence, a definition into a world-law, or an author into a
truth-maker.

outline.label: Use the model with its conditions
outline.proposal: Place the comparability assumptions beside any comparison widget; preserve a Pareto reading when the axes are only independently ordinal.

evidence.text:
If both coordinates are merely ordinal, the invariant comparison is
componentwise Pareto dominance:

```text
N_a ⪰_P N_b  iff  Φ̂₄,a ⪰ Φ̂₄,b  and  V₄,a ⪰ V₄,b,
```

with at least one strict inequality for strict dominance. This survives
independent strictly increasing reparameterizations of the two factors. A
scalar expression such as a product or minimum does not: it compares magnitudes
across axes and therefore requires more structure than ordinal order.

Only after a **calibration contract** declares cardinal scales, meaningful
zeros and units, admissible transformations, uncertainty, domain and
cross-factor comparability may an application define calibration maps

outline.label: Cooperate without erasing the counterexample
outline.proposal: Link the cooperation story to its explicit one-shot counterexample and distinguish model interdependence from chosen admissibility.
